notes: SiphonHook is an observe-only hook: afterSwap reads its own pool's sqrtPriceX96, tick, LP fee and liquidity from the PoolManager, optionally staticcalls getSlot0(bytes32) (selector 0xc815641c) on an owner-set anchor contract, and emits one PoolData(blockNumber, sqrtPriceSelf, tickSelf, sqrtPriceAnchor, tickAnchor, swapAmount, zeroForOne, feeAmount, liquidity) event per swap. It takes no hook fee, returns no delta, uses no transient storage, executes no swaps and holds no funds; the pool's 1.25% LP fee (fee 12500) is the launch policy's and is untouched. Permissions are exactly beforeInitialize and afterSwap (flags 0x2040): beforeInitialize exists only so the pool cannot be initialized before the hook has code; it accepts any caller through the PoolManager and imposes no fee, spacing or currency rule, so the factory opens the ETH/SIPH pool at fee 12500, spacing 60 without restriction. No liquidity callbacks exist, so the factory's zero-liquidity-change fee collect is unaffected. Constructor: (IPoolManager poolManager_, address owner_) -> ($poolManager, $owner); a zero owner reverts; the constructor runs Hooks.validateHookPermissions. Owner (0x735121a546092f31050a867fd7e3a750c7b0eff9 via $owner) may setAnchor(address, bytes32 poolId), setPaused(bool) and transferOwnership(address). The anchor starts as address(0) and the read is skipped until set; a failed or short anchor read reports zeros and never reverts the swap. Pause silences emission and skips the anchor read but never blocks swaps. feeAmount is an estimate: the input actually paid times the pool LP fee over 1e6. swapAmount is params.amountSpecified (negative = exact input). SiphonToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments, no owner, mint, pause, blocklist, fee or upgrade; supply is minted once to the deployer. Runtime of the hook is under 2 KB (via-IR, solc 0.8.26, cancun).
